There are differences in duration, cost, and downtime between the burial method and the incision method.

The double plastic surgery method isburial methodandincision methodThey are broadly divided into two types, and their suitability varies depending on the condition of the eyelids and the desired design.

Characteristics of burial and incision methods and how to choose according to eyelid type
  • The burial method is a procedure in which the eyelids are held in place with threads, which causes less swelling and allows you to return to your daily life in a short period of time.
  • The incision method involves removing the skin, resulting in a semi-permanent double line.
  • If you want eyelids with thick fat or wide double eyelids, the incision method is suitable.
  • If you have eyelid scars or sagging skin, we also recommend treating ptosis at the same time.

It's not about which one is better, but about your own eyelids.Thickness, fat amount, desired double widthBy comparing these three conditions, you can find the treatment method that suits you.

Below, we will summarize the characteristics of each technique and how to choose one for each eyelid type.

The burial method is a procedure in which the eyelids are held in place with threads, which causes less swelling and allows you to return to your daily life in a short period of time.

The burial method involves passing a medical thread through the back of the eyelid and connecting it to the skin.Eyelid plateThis is a treatment that forms a double line by tying the two together.

Because no skin is cut, swelling after the procedure is milder than with incisions, and in most casesAbout 1 to 2 weeksThis allows you to settle into a state where it is difficult for others to notice you.

For example, if you undergo treatment on a Friday night, you may still have some swelling by the end of the week on Monday.Going to work while covering with a mask or makeupThere are many cases where this is possible.

Treatment time is for both eyesAround 30 minutesAs a guideline, pain is kept to a minimum as local anesthesia is used.

Characteristics of eyelids suitable for the burial method
  • Thin eyelid fat and thin skin
  • Desired double width is narrow to medium
  • I want to keep downtime short
  • I want to leave the possibility of reverting back in the future.

On the other hand, if the thread becomes loose or breaks, the double line becomes thinner."Return"The possibility of this occurring is a disadvantage unique to the burial method.

The eyelid fat is thin and the desired double width is achieved.If the area is narrow to medium, the burial method is sufficient.You can expect a beautiful finish.

The duration and price vary depending on the number of threads and the method of fastening, so be sure to check the differences between "2-point fastening" and "4-point fastening" during your consultation.

The incision method involves removing the skin, resulting in a semi-permanent double line.

The incision method involves making an incision in the eyelid skin along the desired double line, removing excess fat and skin, and then suturing it.

Because the skin is physically removed and fixed, there is no concept of the thread loosening, and the double line that is formed issemi-permanentwill be maintained.

However, the downtime is longer than the burial method due to the incision involved, and there is a period when swelling is noticeable after the surgery.1-2 weeks, until the perfect finish is achieved.Approximately 3 to 6 monthsIt is common that it takes.

Stitches removed after surgeryAround 5-7 daysDuring this period, there will be restrictions on washing your face and bathing.

Irreversibility of the procedureis also an important characteristic of the incision method.

With the burial method, there is an option to remove the thread and put it back in place, but with the incision method,Once you do it, you can't go back to the original state.。

The incision method is difficult to correct. Please thoroughly check the design during your consultation and proceed with the treatment only after you are satisfied with it.

In exchange for long-lasting results, it is important to understand that this is a surgical procedure that requires careful prior confirmation before selecting it.

If you want eyelids with thick fat or wide double eyelids, the incision method is suitable.

If your eyelids have thick fat, even if you use the burial method to secure the thread, the weight of the fat will make it difficult to create a stable double eyelid line.Tendency to return fasterThere is.

In this case,fat removalThe incision method, which allows both to be performed at the same time, is easier to achieve a stable finish over the long term.

Also,parallel doubleThe incision method is also suitable if you want a wide design.

This is because if you create wide double eyelids using the burying method, the weight of the eyelids will put more stress on the threads, increasing the risk of the lines collapsing.

The following three points will help you determine whether your eyelids are suitable for the incision method.

Guidelines for receiving counseling based on the incision method
  • Feels thick or hard when you pinch your eyelids
  • Even if you make a line with your fingers, it is difficult to get a double line.
  • The desired duplex width is wide (parallel duplex, etc.)

If your eyelids feel thick or hard when you pinch them, if the double eyelids are difficult to establish even if you create a line with your fingers, or if the desired double eyelid width is wide,Receive counseling based on the incision methodPlease consider that.

Even if your eyelids have thick fat, you can create a clean double eyelid line by combining the incision method and fat removal.

The final decision on the surgical method requires an examination by a doctor, but knowing your eyelid type in advance will allow for more specific counseling.

If you have eyelid scars or sagging skin, we also recommend treating ptosis at the same time.

If you continue to use eyelids for many years, the skin of your eyelids may stretch and become thinner, or the muscles that lift your eyelids (levator palpebrae muscle) may be weakened.

this statePtosisThis is called double eyelid surgery, and the eye opening may not be improved even if you perform double eyelid surgery alone.

Symptoms include heaviness of the eyelids, difficulty opening them, and narrow vision due to drooping eyelids blocking vision. In addition, changes in appearance due to changes in the impression of the eyes are often a problem.

Quote:Ptosis | Explanation of the disease by the Japanese Ophthalmological Society

If you suspect ptosis,Perform double eyelid formation and ptosis correction at the same timeThe surgical method will be an option.

By treating them at the same time, you can correct both eye opening and double eye lines in one treatment, making it easier to be satisfied with the result.

Additionally, if your eyelids are sagging due to aging, you can expect a more natural-looking finish by combining this with an incision method that removes excess skin.

Ptosis correction may be covered by insurance. Please check with the clinic in advance, as there are cases where insurance will not cover the simultaneous treatment with double-plasty for cosmetic purposes.

If you have been using eyelids for a long time or find it difficult to open your eyes, we recommend that you tell your doctor about this during your consultation and have them examine you for ptosis.
